title: CredRequest
description: Credential helper (or git-ssh wrapper) asks for a short-lived token or a standalone repository's credential. Unreliable, retried after 10 s with the same req_id; never logged.

host.description: github.com, or a standalone repository's host[:port].

path.description: owner/name.git (a standalone repository: its path on the host, with .git).

force_refresh.description: Git rejected the token handed out last (credential erase): the console skips its token cache and mints a new one (at most once a minute per token scope).
